allMembershipsInclude: full access to our library of 100+ evidence-based guides, videos and practical resources.

tiers.name: Planwise Partner Package
tiers.whoItSuits: You want ongoing guidance as new questions come up
tiers.whatYouGet: Ongoing tips and guidance relevant to your situation
tiers.providerHelp: We follow up with providers on your behalf
tiers.whichOptionSummary: Suitable if you'd like ongoing access to guidance as new questions or decisions come up over time, without a fixed structure to it.

tiers.name: Family Navigator Package
tiers.overview: Ongoing support for up to 3 family members
tiers.whoItSuits: You're coordinating care for a parent or loved one with other family members
tiers.howOftenYouConnect: Whenever you need guidance, plus a monthly call
tiers.whatYouGet: A shared, updated roadmap the whole family can follow
tiers.planUpdatesOverTime: Your roadmap is updated whenever things change or additional services are needed
tiers.providerHelp: We help you understand providers and follow up on your behalf
tiers.extras: Help with funding body paperwork (e.g. My Aged Care)
tiers.whichOptionSummary: Suitable if you're supporting a family member and want the whole family coordinated around one shared plan, with regular check-ins and help navigating paperwork like My Aged Care.

tiers.name: Ageing Well Comprehensive Package
tiers.whoItSuits: You want a full review done now, with a document to work from
tiers.howOftenYouConnect: One in-depth planning process, plus 30 days of follow-up support
tiers.whatYouGet: A written plan and report covering your situation across the 4 Pillars
tiers.providerHelp: Coaching to prepare for provider conversations
tiers.whichOptionSummary: Suitable if you want a full plan done in one go, covering your situation across all 4 Pillars, with a written report and short-term follow-up support to help you act on it.
